title: Paid a contractor in 2026? Get the W-9 now
label: 1099 season

hook.text: Paid a contractor? Get the *W-9* now

lines: Tom paid a web designer $3,000 this year.
It's late January. She won't reply.
He needs her tax ID for the 1099.

items.s: Card and app payments go on 1099-K instead.

items.t: Email each one a W-9 request
Save the W-9 with their invoices

beats.kicker: All of it in one kit
beats.sub: Who needs a 1099, W-9s and a contractor tracker.

captions.instagram:
Paid a contractor this year? Ask for the W-9 in December, while they still answer emails.

✔️ For payments made in 2026, Form 1099-NEC is needed at $2,000 or more (up from $600).
✔️ Forms go to contractors by Feb. 1, 2027 (Jan. 31 is a Sunday).
✔️ Payments by card or payment app go on Form 1099-K instead, from the platform.
✔️ This week: list everyone you paid, email each a W-9 request, and save the W-9 with their invoices.

The 1099 Kit covers who needs a form, W-9 collection and a contractor tracker.

sources.fact: For tax years beginning after 2025 the 1099-NEC threshold is $2,000; card and third-party network payments go on Form 1099-K; due Jan. 31, moved to the next business day (Feb. 1, 2027) (read 2026-10-24, spec 1099-2000-rule; within 30 days)
